description:
Round-2 codex finding 1 (High) on gap 2808: protocol.file_patches (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/protocol.py ~160) gives a first hunk with no function heading the constant 'first', and _heading_gap (~129) collides when the heading text repeats, so a relocated edit hashes the same as the original and plan_round CARRYs the earlier SHIP. Codex produced identical fingerprints for requires_auth edits at hunk starts 4 and 15 and a repeated-heading variant reaching plan_round CARRY. This was a disclosed residual risk of the merged relocation fix (headingless first hunks indistinguishable from a rebase shift).

DECISION GATE: reproduce first with real git diffs (headingless hunk at two positions; repeated heading). The fix must keep: a pure rebase keeps the hash; a relocation changes it (test_a_binary_change_is_never_mistaken_for_an_unchanged_patch and the shifted-hunk tests stay unchanged). If no design satisfies both for headingless hunks, STOP and report the options with evidence: owner decision needed (candidate: treat a headingless first hunk as always changed so it is re-reviewed, accepting extra re-reviews).

GUARDRAILS: never post a stand-in or any oracle comment; never rerun or dispatch the oracle; oracle verdict required on the PR (soundness path); no pre-registered digests; never weaken a gate; no skip/xfail; never bypass a hook by any route (no SKIP=, --no-verify, commit-tree); primary clone read-only (make worktree-create, absolute worktree paths, no git stash, no git add -A, identity Joe Harris); no CHANGELOG entry; no code comments/docstrings; always encoding utf-8; PR text for a reader who never saw the session; done = merged PR plus evidence.
